ja: Time_Level は時間軸上の位置（Box の Time_Level と同じ目盛り）です。帯の表示では、各時期の Time_Level を代表点として、区切りは隣り合う 2 つの時期の Time_Level のちょうど中間に引かれ、ラベルは区切りと区切りの真ん中に置かれます（両端は時間矢印の端）。そのため 1 つの値を変えると両側の区切りが動き、隣の時期の値を越えると順番が入れ替わります。区切りを置きたい位置の前後に、各時期の値を置いてください（範囲は右の列で確認できます）。
en: Time_Level is the position on the time axis (the same scale as a Box's Time_Level). In the band display, each period's Time_Level is its representative point: a divider is drawn exactly halfway between the Time_Levels of two neighboring periods, and the label is placed midway between its dividers (the outer ends are the ends of the time arrow). So changing one value moves the dividers on both sides, and passing a neighbor's value swaps their order. Place each period's value on either side of where you want a divider (check the ranges in the right column).
note: 時期ラベルの画面 > 下の説明（帯の表示のとき）
